sub_section: Welcome to the unit
original_sentence: Until her baby's old enough to leave the nest.
readingExamples: Until her baby's old enough to leave the nest.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a structure built by birds to hold their eggs and shelter their young
(2) n. a place where insects or small animals live and breed, such as a wasps' nest or a mouse's nest
(3) n. a warm, safe and comfortable home, especially the family home that children eventually leave
(4) vi. to build a nest and live or lay eggs in it

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 筑巢;(鸟)在某处栖息繁殖
uncommonMeanings.example: Every spring, a pair of swallows nested under the eaves of Grandma's house, and their cheerful chirping became the alarm clock of my childhood. （读后续写·童年回忆·环境描写）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 安乐窝;避风港(比喻家庭的庇护)
uncommonMeanings.example: College was calling, yet part of him clung to the familiar nest — the smell of his mother's cooking, the creaky stairs, the quiet certainty of being loved. （读后续写·离家成长·心理描写）

posExamples.sentence: Holding her breath, Lucy parted the branches and found the nest — three pale blue eggs lay inside, fragile and perfect, glowing softly in the morning light. （读后续写·自然探索·细节描写）
I am writing to invite you to join our bird-watching club, where members record how birds build nests and raise their young in the campus garden. （应用文·邀请信）
Just as young birds must leave the nest to learn to fly, teenagers need space to make their own decisions — overprotection, however well-intentioned, only delays their flight. （议论文·独立成长·类比论证）
Scientists observed that the rare cranes returned to nest in the restored wetland, powerful proof that years of environmental protection truly pay off. （应用文·调查报告）

wordForms.other: nestling (n. 雏鸟); nestle (v. 依偎,安卧)

idioms.translation: 离巢;离开父母独立生活
idioms.example: The day I left the nest for university, Dad said nothing, but at the station he hugged me longer than he ever had before. （读后续写·亲情离别）

idioms.translation: 空巢(子女离家后的家庭)
idioms.example: Facing an empty nest, my parents finally picked up the hobbies they had set aside for twenty years — proof that love also means learning to let go. （读后续写·亲情主题升华）

The official was widely criticized for feathering his own nest instead of serving the public interest. （议论文·社会诚信）

collocations.example: High in the old oak, two magpies were busy building a nest, weaving twigs together with astonishing patience. （读后续写·自然观察）

Psychologists point out that children who are encouraged to leave the nest at the proper time tend to adapt to society better. （议论文·独立教育）
Warning signs were put up after a wasps' nest was discovered near the playground, and all students are asked to keep clear of the area. （应用文·通知）
Our exchange students will visit the Bird's Nest, the main stadium of the 2008 Beijing Olympics, on the second day of the tour. （应用文·行程安排）
However far the young eagle flies, instinct always tells it where the nest lies — and so it is with us and home. （读后续写·主题升华）

synonyms.example: Rabbits dig complex burrows to escape from the cold and from predators. （应用文·科普介绍）

synonyms.example: For the homeless man, the tiny room was more than a shelter; it was the first place in years he could call his own. （读后续写·温情主题）

advancedExpressions.expression: encourage sb. to leave the nest and spread their wings

advancedExpressions.expression: a nest, however warm, is never meant to ...

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is widely acknowledged that 正式开头 + just as 类比 + for it is...that 强调句说理

sub_section: Pre-reading
original_sentence: What do you think "strangers under the same roof" means?
readingExamples: What do you think "strangers under the same roof" means?
definitionEn:
(1) n. the structure that covers or forms the top of a building, vehicle, etc.
(2) n. the top part of the inside of your mouth (the roof of the mouth)
(3) n. the highest point or upper surface of something (e.g. the roof of the world)
(4) vt. to cover a building with a roof

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 上腭(口腔的顶部)
uncommonMeanings.example: The peanut butter stuck to the roof of his mouth, and for one merciful moment the talkative boy fell silent. （读后续写·幽默细节）

synonyms.example: Lying on his bed, Tom stared at the ceiling, replaying the argument with his father word by word. （读后续写·心理描写）
synonyms.usage: ceiling 指室内头顶的天花板,也可指数量'上限';roof 指建筑物外部的屋顶

synonyms.example: The bus stop offered little shelter from the driving rain, so we squeezed together under Grandpa's old umbrella. （读后续写·风雨温情）
synonyms.usage: shelter 强调'遮蔽、保护'的功能;roof 表'栖身处'时须用习语 a roof over one's head

advancedExpressions.expression: rain drummed / hammered on the roof as ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: The rain fell on the roof.

sub_section: Article: Strangers under the same roof?
original_sentence: Does every dinner with your parents seem to turn into a battle?
readingExamples: Does every dinner with your parents seem to turn into a battle?
definitionEn:
(1) n. a fight between armed forces, ships or planes, especially during a war
(2) n. a violent argument, or a competition between people or groups striving for power or success
(3) n. a determined effort to solve a difficult problem or overcome something unpleasant (a battle against disease / for survival)
(4) v. to fight or struggle hard against sb/sth; to keep trying in a very difficult situation

posExamples.sentence: What began as a quiet dinner soon turned into a battle of raised voices, and Amy fled upstairs, slamming the door on her parents' unfinished sentences. （读后续写·家庭冲突·动作细节）
Battling against the biting wind, the exhausted runner fixed his eyes on the finish line, telling himself that giving up was the only real failure. （读后续写·体育励志）
This orientation programme is designed to help freshmen win the battle against homesickness through weekly group activities and heart-to-heart talks. （应用文·活动介绍）
The battle against procrastination is never won overnight; it demands clear goals, small steps and, above all, the courage to start right now. （议论文·自我管理·排比论证）

idioms.translation: 打一场必败之仗;徒劳挣扎
idioms.example: Trying to keep the beach clean all by himself, the old man seemed to be fighting a losing battle — until the whole village joined him one Sunday morning. （读后续写·环保·感人转折）

idioms.translation: 成功的一半;最难的部分已完成
idioms.example: As our teacher often reminds us, a calm and confident beginning is half the battle in any examination. （应用文·经验分享）

collocations.example: She lost the first battle with her nerves, but that failure taught her how to win the war against stage fright. （读后续写·成长主题）
A heated battle over whether to tear down the old gym broke out at the student council meeting. （应用文·会议报道）
Throughout her battle against illness, Grandma never lost her gentle smile, which taught me more about courage than any book ever could. （读后续写·亲情励志）
For the stranded climbers, the freezing night became a battle for survival that tested both their bodies and their bond. （读后续写·险境互助）
Discussions about screen time often turn into a battle in many families, which could be avoided with a rule made jointly by both sides. （议论文·亲子沟通）

The two best debate teams will battle it out in the school hall this Friday afternoon — everyone is welcome to come and cheer. （应用文·海报）
The inventor was dragged into a long legal battle over the ownership of his design. （议论文·知识产权·例证）

synonyms.example: After years of struggle, the deaf dancer finally stood in the spotlight of the national stage. （读后续写·励志）

word: see eye to eye with sb (on sth)
translation: 在某事上与人看法一致
sub_section: Article: Strangers under the same roof?
original_sentence: Do you feel that you just cannot see eye to eye with them on anything?
readingExamples: Do you feel that you just cannot see eye to eye with them on anything?
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to agree with someone about something; to share exactly the same opinion
(2) phr. (usually in negative sentences) to hold a different view from someone, often causing tension or distance

posExamples.sentence: Grandpa and I never saw eye to eye on music — until the evening he heard me play his favourite folk song on my electric guitar, and his stern face softened into a smile. （读后续写·代际和解）
Although we didn't see eye to eye on the theme at first, our group finally reached an agreement through patient discussion, which taught me the true value of listening. （应用文·心得分享）
Parents and teenagers may not see eye to eye on everything, but respecting each other's viewpoint matters far more than winning every argument. （议论文·家庭沟通·让步论证）

collocations.phrase: see eye to eye with sb
collocations.example: It took Jack years to see eye to eye with his father on what success really means. （读后续写·成长感悟）

collocations.phrase: see eye to eye on / about sth
collocations.example: The twins rarely see eye to eye on clothes, yet they always defend each other the moment trouble comes. （读后续写·亲情细节）

collocations.translation: 意见不合(最常见的否定用法)
collocations.example: My desk mate and I don't always see eye to eye, but our differences often spark better ideas for the class project. （应用文·合作感悟）

collocations.phrase: seldom / rarely see eye to eye
collocations.example: Though the two scientists seldom saw eye to eye, their fierce debates kept pushing the research forward. （议论文·分歧的价值·例证）

synonyms.example: I quite agree with you on the necessity of daily exercise, and I would like to add one more suggestion. （应用文·回信）

synonyms.translation: 看法一致,达成共识(口语)

synonyms.usage: 口语色彩浓,强调对目标或情况'理解一致';see eye to eye 强调观点、立场相同

synonyms.usage: 正式书面表达,常用于议论文引述观点;see eye to eye 更口语化、更具画面感

sub_section: Article: Strangers under the same roof?
original_sentence: Heated arguments and cold silences are common between teenagers and their parents.
readingExamples: Heated arguments and cold silences are common between teenagers and their parents.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a disagreement or quarrel, especially an angry one, in which people exchange heated words
(2) n. a reason or set of reasons given to support or oppose an idea, action or opinion
(3) n. the act or process of reasoning and debating; discussion based on logic

posExamples.sentence: The argument over her test scores ended with a slammed door, and in the sudden silence, both mother and daughter regretted the words they could not take back. （读后续写·冲突余波·心理描写）

advancedExpressions.expression: only when/after ... did sb. begin to calm down
advancedExpressions.example: Only when the rescue helicopter's searchlight swept across the valley did the trapped climbers begin to calm down, hope thawing the fear in their eyes. （only 状语+倒装，续写转机段）

advancedExpressions.expression: my first piece of advice is to calm down before ...
advancedExpressions.example: My first piece of advice is to calm down before you say anything you might regret, because words, once spoken, can never truly be taken back. （建议信分点句式+因果支撑）

advancedExpressions.expression: admittedly, it is easier said than done to calm down when ..., yet ...
advancedExpressions.example: Admittedly, it is easier said than done to calm down when your opinions are being dismissed, yet it is precisely at such moments that composure proves its worth. （让步+强调句回击，显思辨性）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was angry, but he calmed down after a while.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Anger flared in his chest like a struck match, but he counted silently to ten, unclenched his fists finger by finger, and felt the storm inside him gradually calm down into a manageable drizzle. （读后续写·愤怒平息·延展隐喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 明喻(like a struck match)写怒气 + 动作分解(counted to ten / unclenched finger by finger) + 天气隐喻贯穿(storm→drizzle)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Please calm down and we can talk about it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I completely understand your frustration, but I sincerely suggest that we both calm down first, so that we can discuss the matter thoroughly and reach a solution acceptable to us both. （应用文·协商信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 先共情(I understand your frustration)再建议的应用文套路 + suggest that 虚拟语气 + so that 目的从句给出冷静的意义

translation: 看法；视线；景色；把…视为；观看
sub_section: Article: Strangers under the same roof?
original_sentence: When you disagree with your parents, take a minute to calm down and try to understand the situation from their point of view.
readingExamples: When you disagree with your parents, take a minute to calm down and try to understand the situation from their point of view.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a personal opinion, belief or attitude about something
(2) n. what you can see from a particular place, especially beautiful scenery
(3) n. the ability to see something from a particular place; sight
(4) vt. to think about or consider someone or something in a particular way
(5) vt. to look at or watch something, especially carefully or formally

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 视野，视线（尤用于 come into view / block one's view 等）
uncommonMeanings.example: Just as despair was setting in, the lights of a farmhouse came into view through the fog, and we half-ran, half-stumbled towards that trembling promise of warmth. （读后续写·迷路获救·希望意象）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 参观，查看（房屋、展品等）
uncommonMeanings.example: Visitors are welcome to view the students' calligraphy works in the school gallery, where each piece is accompanied by an English introduction. （应用文·活动通知）

posExamples.sentence: Standing at the summit, we drank in the breathtaking view below — ribbons of river silvering the valley — and every blister on my feet suddenly seemed a small price to pay. （读后续写·登山·先抑后扬）
I am writing to share my views on the proposed mobile-phone policy: while I support limiting phone use in class, a total ban, in my view, would go a step too far. （应用文·意见信）
Instead of viewing failure as a wall that blocks our way, we would be wiser to view it as a mirror that shows us exactly where improvement is needed. （议论文·失败观·对比隐喻）
When you disagree with your parents, try to understand the situation from their point of view first; the same mountain, after all, looks entirely different from the other side. （议论文·换位思考·类比）

wordForms.noun: view / viewer (观众，观看者) / viewing (观看；参观)

idioms.example: In view of the approaching storm, the sports meeting scheduled for tomorrow will be postponed until further notice. （应用文·通知）

idioms.idiom: with a view to doing sth.
idioms.example: Our school has launched a buddy programme with a view to helping new students adapt to campus life more smoothly. （应用文·介绍信/新闻报道）

idioms.translation: 在……众目睽睽之下，完全看得见的地方
idioms.example: In full view of the whole class, Tom walked up and admitted the broken window was his doing — and the room, instead of laughing, burst into applause. （读后续写·诚实担当·反转）
Reading novels told from a stranger's point of view quietly trains us in empathy, the very skill our divided world needs most. （议论文·阅读的意义）

collocations.example: Seen from my parents' point of view, their endless reminders were not control but clumsy translations of the word 'love'. （读后续写·亲子和解·感悟）
The forum offers students and teachers a precious chance to exchange views on how homework could be made both lighter and smarter. （应用文·活动介绍）
I hold the view that a true friend is not one who always agrees with you, but one who tells you the truth kindly. （议论文·友谊观）
In my view, the generation gap is less a wall to be knocked down than a bridge waiting to be built, plank by patient plank. （议论文·比喻论证）

collocations.translation: 令人惊叹的/全景的/壮观的景色
collocations.example: The glass observation deck commands a panoramic view of the city, which makes it the highlight of our proposed one-day tour. （应用文·行程推荐）
Arriving two hours early, we secured front-row seats and had a perfect view of every dragon boat slicing through the water. （读后续写·民俗活动）
A tall man's umbrella blocked my view of the stage, but before I could sigh, he noticed, smiled, and folded it at once. （读后续写·陌生人善意·微小美好）
As the train rounded the bend, the sea came into view at last, and the whole carriage seemed to inhale at the same time. （读后续写·旅途·集体反应）
Rather than viewing chores as a burden, teenagers might view them as daily rehearsals for an independent life. （议论文·劳动教育）

synonyms.example: In my opinion, honest communication, however uncomfortable at first, is always kinder than comfortable silence. （议论文·沟通主题）
synonyms.usage: opinion 是"看法"的最通用词，主观色彩明显；view 常指经过思考形成的较系统的观点，且另有"景色、视野"等义

synonyms.translation: 风景（不可数，指自然风光整体）
synonyms.example: The mountain scenery along the route was so stunning that our guide had to keep reminding photographers to watch their step. （读后续写·旅行·幽默）
synonyms.usage: scenery 不可数，指某地自然风光的总体；view 可数，指从某一位置看到的具体景象，故说 a room with a view 而非 a scenery

synonyms.example: The sight of her father waiting at the school gate in the pouring rain, holding two umbrellas, was one she would carry for the rest of her life. （读后续写·父爱·定格画面）
synonyms.usage: sight 强调"看到的一幕"或视力本身，the sights 指名胜；view 强调从特定视角望出去的画面或抽象观点

synonyms.example: True educators regard every mistake in class as a teaching opportunity rather than a fault to be punished. （议论文·教育理念）
synonyms.usage: regard...as 与 view...as 基本同义可互换，regard 稍更正式；view...as 在书面议论中同样地道

advancedExpressions.expression: as ... came into view, sb. realized ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the familiar red roof of home came into view, Amy suddenly realized that what she had been running away from was exactly what she had been searching for. （景物触发顿悟，续写结尾点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: from a long-term point of view, it would be more sensible to ...
advancedExpressions.example: From a long-term point of view, it would be more sensible to invest the fund in the school library than in a one-off celebration. （视角框架+委婉比较，提建议显成熟）

advancedExpressions.expression: while some hold the view that ..., I am firmly convinced that ...
advancedExpressions.example: While some hold the view that the generation gap is unbridgeable, I am firmly convinced that regular, honest dialogue can narrow even the widest divide. （让步引出对立观点+旗帜鲜明的立论）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The view from the top was beautiful.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: From the wind-swept summit, the view unfolded like a scroll of ink-wash painting — terraced fields stitched with mist, a river looping lazily into the horizon — and for a long moment none of us dared to speak, afraid of smudging the silence. （读后续写·景物描写·通感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 明喻(a scroll of ink-wash painting)化景为画 + 破折号插入具体意象(terraced fields / looping river) + 以"不敢出声"的反应侧面烘托美景

sentenceUpgrade.original: You should understand your parents' view.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Only by stepping into your parents' shoes and viewing the disagreement from their perspective can you appreciate that behind every stern rule lies an unspoken fear of seeing you hurt. （议论文·only 倒装+换位思考）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Only by doing 倒装强调方法 + stepping into one's shoes 习语显换位 + behind...lies 倒装揭示深层动机，升华亲子主题

translation: 从某人的角度，观点出发
sub_section: Article: Strangers under the same roof?
original_sentence: When you disagree with your parents, take a minute to calm down and try to understand the situation from their point of view.
readingExamples: When you disagree with your parents, take a minute to calm down and try to understand the situation from their point of view.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. used to introduce the way a particular person thinks or feels about a situation
(2) phr. considering a matter from the position or standpoint of a particular person or group, especially one different from your own
(3) phr. (from a ... point of view) as far as one particular aspect of a situation is concerned, e.g. from a practical / financial / environmental point of view

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (point of view 在文学/写作中)叙事视角(第一人称、第三人称等)
uncommonMeanings.example: Our teacher asked us to rewrite the story's ending from the mother's point of view, and only when I picked up my pen did I finally understand the weight behind her silence. （读后续写·视角转换·亲情理解）

posExamples.sentence: Standing in the doorway with the torn letter in my hand, I suddenly saw the whole quarrel from my father's point of view — behind his harsh words lay nothing but a fear of losing me. （读后续写·家庭矛盾·心理转折）
"Put yourself in her shoes for a moment," Grandma said softly, stroking my hair. "From Lily's point of view, you didn't just lose her kite — you broke a promise." （读后续写·对话描写·友谊修复）

From my point of view, setting up a book-sharing corner in our classroom would not only enrich our spare time but also strengthen the bond among classmates, so I sincerely hope you will consider this suggestion. （应用文·建议信）

Looked at from an environmental point of view, the convenience of food delivery comes at a heavy price, for the mountains of plastic containers it produces will burden the planet for centuries to come. （议论文·环境保护）

collocations.example: From my point of view, the school sports meeting should be held in October, when the weather is neither burning hot nor bitterly cold. （应用文·建议信）

collocations.phrase: from a practical / scientific / economic point of view
collocations.translation: 从实用 / 科学 / 经济的角度来看
collocations.example: From a practical point of view, learning to cook simple meals prepares senior students for independent life far better than any lecture on self-reliance ever could. （议论文·生活技能）

collocations.phrase: see / look at sth from sb's point of view
collocations.translation: 从某人的角度看待某事
collocations.example: It was not easy to look at the punishment from Coach Wang's point of view, but deep down I knew that his strictness had saved me from a far worse fall. （读后续写·师生关系·反思）

collocations.phrase: understand sth from sb's point of view
collocations.translation: 站在某人的立场理解某事
collocations.example: When you disagree with your host family, try to understand the house rules from their point of view before jumping to the conclusion that they are being unfair. （应用文·建议信·交换生生活）
Although not everyone shares my point of view, I firmly believe that failure, honestly examined, teaches lessons that success can never offer. （议论文·挫折教育）
The English corner offers us a relaxing platform where students and foreign teachers can exchange points of view on culture, study and daily life. （应用文·活动介绍）

collocations.phrase: from the point of view of sb/sth
collocations.example: From the point of view of long-term health, sacrificing sleep for extra study hours is a bargain in which the loser is always ourselves. （议论文·作息与健康）

synonyms.example: Travelling alone across three provinces gave me a fresh perspective on how vast and varied my own country truly is. （读后续写/应用文·旅行感悟）
synonyms.usage: 更正式抽象,常用于 from a ... perspective / gain a new perspective;议论文中可替换 point of view 提升文采

synonyms.example: From a legal standpoint, downloading pirated films is theft, however harmless it may feel behind a glowing screen. （议论文·网络道德）
synonyms.usage: 强调基于身份、利益或专业的立场(from a legal/moral standpoint),比 point of view 更书面

synonyms.example: In my opinion, the proposed reading week deserves our full support, for nothing nourishes a young mind like unhurried reading. （应用文·倡议回信）
synonyms.usage: 直接给出个人结论;from one's point of view 更强调'从某个角度出发看问题'的过程,而非结论本身

advancedExpressions.expression: It was not until ... that I began to see ... from sb's point of view.
advancedExpressions.example: It was not until I found the worn photo in his wallet that I began to see those endless phone calls from Dad's point of view — not as control, but as love that didn't know a softer language. （not until 强调句+破折号补释,续写高潮段的认知反转）

advancedExpressions.expression: From my point of view, it would be advisable to ..., which ...
advancedExpressions.example: From my point of view, it would be advisable to invite senior students to share their experience first, which would make the coming Career Day both practical and inspiring. （观点+建议+which 从句补充效果,建议信主体段模板）

advancedExpressions.expression: From the point of view of ..., ...; yet viewed from ..., the picture changes entirely.
advancedExpressions.example: From the point of view of convenience, mobile payment is an unmixed blessing; yet viewed from that of privacy, the picture changes entirely. （双视角对照论证,体现思辨性,可作议论文让步段框架）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I understood my mother when I saw things from her point of view.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Only when I forced myself to see that rainy evening from my mother's point of view — a woman waiting by a cold dinner, phone pressed to her ear — did understanding wash over me like the rain outside. （读后续写·心理描写+画面感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Only when...did 倒装 + 破折号插入具体画面(cold dinner, phone pressed to her ear) + 比喻(wash over me like the rain)

sentenceUpgrade.original: From my point of view, students should exercise more.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: From my point of view, incorporating a daily thirty-minute exercise session into our timetable is not a luxury but a necessity, for a sharpened mind always begins with an awakened body. （议论文·观点陈述）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 动名词主语正式化 + not...but 对照结构 + for 引导的格言式论证收尾

translation: 充分考虑，全盘考虑，想透
sub_section: Article: Strangers under the same roof?
original_sentence: After you have thought it through, explain your actions and feelings calmly, listen carefully, and address their concerns.
readingExamples: After you have thought it through, explain your actions and feelings calmly, listen carefully, and address their concerns.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to think carefully about the possible results or consequences of a plan, decision, action, etc. before you act
(2) phr. to consider all the details of a problem in a thorough, organized way until you fully understand it
(3) phr. (think things through) to take time to reflect calmly before making up your mind, especially when emotions are running high

posExamples.sentence: Instead of firing back an angry reply, Amy set down her phone, took a deep breath and forced herself to think the whole matter through — was one careless remark really worth a ten-year friendship? （读后续写·心理描写·友谊冲突）

Father spread the map across the kitchen table and made me think our route through step by step, for in the mountains, he said, a plan half thought through is more dangerous than no plan at all. （读后续写·父子出行·对话哲理）

Before you choose which club to join, I strongly advise you to think it through: list what you truly enjoy, weigh the time each activity demands, and consult your teachers if any doubt remains. （应用文·建议信）
Many teenagers rush to follow online trends without thinking them through, which explains why cultivating independent judgement has become an increasingly urgent task for modern education. （议论文·独立思考）

collocations.translation: 把事情想清楚,考虑周全
collocations.example: "Sleep on it and think things through," Grandpa advised, tapping his pipe gently. "The river will still be there tomorrow, and so will your decision." （读后续写·长辈智慧·对话）
Had he thought through the consequences of skipping training, he would never have gambled his place on the team for one afternoon of video games. （读后续写·后悔与教训）

collocations.translation: 全盘考虑一项计划 / 决定
collocations.example: Our committee has thought through every detail of the charity sale plan, from stall arrangement to rainy-day backup, so please rest assured about its feasibility. （应用文·活动方案）
A wise consumer thinks a purchase through carefully instead of surrendering to the hypnotic countdown of a live-streaming sale. （议论文·理性消费）

collocations.phrase: need time to think things through
collocations.example: I appreciate your kind invitation to the summer camp, but I need a few days to think things through, as my grandmother's health remains my first concern. （应用文·回复信）
He blurted out the secret without thinking it through, and the moment the words left his mouth, the colour drained from his best friend's face. （读后续写·冲动与愧疚）

synonyms.example: Please consider the feelings of the new student before you laugh at his accent; kindness costs nothing but means everything. （应用文·倡议）
synonyms.usage: 泛指'考虑',程度较浅;think through 强调从头到尾推演、把后果想透,过程更完整

synonyms.example: She weighed up the pros and cons of studying abroad for a whole week before giving her parents a final answer. （读后续写/应用文·抉择）
synonyms.usage: 强调在两个或多个选项之间比较利弊,常与 pros and cons、options 搭配

synonyms.example: The old carpenter mulled over the design for days, turning the sketch this way and that under the lamp. （读后续写·匠人精神）
synonyms.usage: 口语化,强调长时间慢慢地想,未必得出结论;think through 则以'想清楚'为目标

advancedExpressions.expression: Only after thinking the matter through did sb ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only after thinking the matter through beneath the quiet stars did Jack knock on his rival's door, an apology rehearsed and a handshake ready. （only after 倒装+环境烘托,表现人物由冲动到成熟的转变）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would suggest that you think ... through before ..., taking ... into account.
advancedExpressions.example: I would suggest that you think the choice through before submitting your application, taking your interests, strengths and family's expectations into account. （虚拟语气建议+现在分词伴随状语,建议信高分句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: Decisions made without being thought through often ..., whereas ...
advancedExpressions.example: Decisions made without being thought through often collapse at the first obstacle, whereas choices built on careful reflection can weather even the fiercest storm. （过去分词后置定语+whereas 对比论证+隐喻）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She thought it through and then made her decision.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: All night she thought it through, the arguments circling in her head like moths around a lamp, and when dawn finally slid through the curtains, her decision lay before her, quiet and certain. （读后续写·心理描写+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 独立主格(the arguments circling...) + 明喻(like moths around a lamp) + 环境暗示时间流逝(dawn slid through the curtains) + 尾句短促收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: You should think it through before you quit the team.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Before handing in your resignation from the team, it is essential that you think the decision through thoroughly, for a choice made in the heat of anger is rarely one we are proud of in the calm of hindsight. （应用文·建议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: it is essential that 虚拟语气 + before 分词短语前置 + heat of anger 与 calm of hindsight 对仗式格言收尾

translation: 担心，忧虑；关心；涉及；让(某人)担忧
sub_section: Article: Strangers under the same roof?
original_sentence: After you have thought it through, explain your actions and feelings calmly, listen carefully, and address their concerns.
readingExamples: After you have thought it through, explain your actions and feelings calmly, listen carefully, and address their concerns.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a feeling of worry, especially one shared by many people; something that causes such worry
(2) n. something that matters to you, that you feel is important, or that is your responsibility
(3) vt. to make someone feel worried or troubled
(4) vt. to be about a particular subject; to involve or affect someone (often passive: be concerned with / in)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 公司,企业(如 a going concern 经营状况良好的企业;a family concern 家族企业)
uncommonMeanings.example: The dusty little bookshop, once a thriving family concern passed down through three generations, now survived on the loyalty of a handful of grey-haired customers. （读后续写·老店情怀·时代变迁）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (concern oneself with / about)操心,费心关注
uncommonMeanings.example: "Don't concern yourself with the bill," the old gentleman said with a wink, sliding the money across the counter before the startled boy could utter a word of protest. （读后续写·陌生人的善意）

posExamples.sentence: Watching the worry lines deepen on Mum's forehead, I suddenly realized that my safety had always been her greatest concern, one she had carried in silence through every stormy night I came home late. （读后续写·亲情·心理描写）

I am writing to express my concern about the newly shortened lunch break, which has left many students bolting down their meals and hurrying back to class without a moment of genuine rest. （应用文·建议信/投诉信）

What concerns educators most is not that students use artificial intelligence, but that some of them let it think in their place, quietly surrendering the very ability education is meant to build. （议论文·AI 与教育）
The new traffic regulation concerns every family in our neighbourhood, so all residents are warmly invited to attend the public hearing at the community centre this Saturday morning. （应用文·通知）

wordForms.adjective: concerned(担忧的;有关的);concerning(令人担忧的)

idioms.idiom: as far as sb / sth is concerned
idioms.example: As far as most parents are concerned, a safe route to school matters more than a shorter one — a truth city planners would do well to remember. （议论文·城市规划/校园安全）

idioms.translation: 敬启者(不知收信人姓名时的正式信首称呼)
idioms.example: The recommendation letter began with the formal words "To whom it may concern", yet every line beneath them glowed with the warmth of a teacher who truly knew her student. （读后续写/应用文·推荐信场景）

collocations.example: At the class meeting, several students voiced concern over the mounting homework, and our head teacher, to everyone's relief, promised to coordinate with the subject teachers. （应用文·会议记录/报道）
There is growing concern among parents that short videos are quietly nibbling away at children's patience for anything longer than fifteen seconds. （议论文·媒介素养）

collocations.phrase: a cause for concern / a matter of concern
collocations.example: The falling number of students who exercise daily is a real cause for concern, for a generation's health is being traded for a few extra points. （议论文·体质健康）
True friendship is shown not in grand gestures but in small moments — a classmate who shows concern for you when you fail is worth a hundred who cheer when you win. （议论文·友谊）

collocations.translation: 某人最关心的事,首要考虑
collocations.example: Our primary concern in organizing the mountain hike is safety, so every participant is required to attend the training session and travel in groups of four. （应用文·活动通知）
Deeply concerned about her grandfather's failing eyesight, Mei read the newspaper aloud to him every evening, her voice a lamp his eyes no longer needed to be. （读后续写·祖孙情·细节描写）
This programme is chiefly concerned with protecting the wetland birds, and volunteers will record their numbers, habits and nesting sites every weekend. （应用文·招募启事）

collocations.translation: 回应 / 消除某人的担忧
collocations.example: Instead of dismissing your parents' doubts, address their concerns one by one with facts and patience, and you will often find the door you thought locked was merely closed. （应用文·建议信·亲子沟通）

synonyms.example: Her biggest worry was that the heavy rain would wash out the open-air concert she had spent two months preparing. （读后续写·活动筹备）
synonyms.usage: 口语常用,多指个人的、具体的担心;concern 更正式,常指公众或群体共同的忧虑,也可指'关切的事务'

synonyms.example: As the results were about to be announced, anxiety crept over the hall like a cold mist, hushing even the most talkative students. （读后续写·考试放榜·氛围描写）
synonyms.usage: 程度深于 concern/worry,强调伴随紧张情绪的不安状态,常与 about/over 连用

synonyms.example: Wrapped in Grandma's handmade scarf, I could feel her care in every stitch, warmer than any winter coat money could buy. （读后续写·亲情·细节）
synonyms.usage: 侧重'在意与照料'(show care for);concern 侧重'挂念与忧虑',感情色彩更凝重

synonyms.example: A vague unease settled over the campers as the wind changed direction and the birds fell strangely silent. （读后续写·危机铺垫·环境描写）
synonyms.usage: 指说不清缘由的轻度不安,程度轻于 anxiety,续写中常用于埋伏笔

advancedExpressions.expression: It was sb's quiet concern, not ..., that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was Mum's quiet concern, not her lectures, that finally melted my stubbornness — the glass of warm milk on my desk said everything her words could not. （强调句+not...对照+细节意象,续写结尾情感升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to express my deep concern about ..., which ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing to express my deep concern about the poorly lit road outside our school gate, which has already caused several near-accidents on winter evenings. （应用文开头亮明来意+which 从句陈述后果,投诉信/建议信万能框架）

advancedExpressions.expression: What should concern us is not ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: What should concern us is not whether machines can think, but whether humans, spoiled by convenience, will still bother to. （what 主语从句+not...but 对照+省略修辞,议论文点题金句）

sentenceUpgrade.original: My mother was concerned about me.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Though she never said a word, my mother's concern followed me everywhere — folded into my schoolbag with the umbrella, waiting on the table in a bowl of soup that was always, somehow, still warm. （读后续写·亲情·细节描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: though 让步从句开篇 + 化抽象为具体(concern 物化为雨伞、热汤) + 破折号列举细节 + 副词插入(always, somehow)营造温情

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many people are concerned about food safety.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Food safety has become a matter of widespread public concern, for what ends up on our plates is never merely a private choice but a mirror of how responsibly a society runs. （议论文·食品安全）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: a matter of widespread public concern 名词化升级 + for 因果论证 + not merely...but 递进 + mirror 隐喻

sub_section: Article: Strangers under the same roof?
original_sentence: Through this kind of healthy discussion, you will learn when to back down and when to ask your parents to relax their control.
readingExamples: Through this kind of healthy discussion, you will learn when to back down and when to ask your parents to relax their control.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to admit that you were wrong or that you cannot win an argument, and stop insisting on your demand or opinion
(2) phr. (back down on / from sth) to withdraw a claim, demand or threat that you made earlier
(3) phr. to yield under pressure rather than continue a confrontation

posExamples.sentence: The two boys glared at each other across the overturned chessboard, neither willing to back down, until the coach's calm voice cut through the tension like a knife through fog. （读后续写·冲突场面·环境烘托）
To everyone's astonishment, the timid girl refused to back down; her voice trembled at first, yet every word landed as firmly as a hammer on the stunned silence of the hall. （读后续写·勇气·细节描写）
When you and your desk-mate disagree over trifles, backing down is not a sign of weakness but of wisdom, for a warm friendship is worth far more than a won argument. （应用文·建议信）
True dialogue does not mean forcing the other side to back down; rather, it means both parties stepping closer until they can see the world through each other's eyes. （议论文·沟通与包容）

collocations.example: Although the whole class laughed at his "impossible" recycling plan, Leo refused to back down, and one year later the campus was dotted with the sorting bins he had designed. （读后续写·坚持己见·励志）

collocations.phrase: back down on / from a demand / claim / threat
collocations.translation: 收回要求 / 说法 / 威胁,在……上让步
collocations.example: Seeing the children's eager rehearsal through the window, the manager finally backed down from his demand that the hall be cleared by five o'clock. （读后续写·转机时刻）
No amount of booing from the stands could force the young referee to back down, for fairness, he believed, was not a matter of popularity. （读后续写/议论文·原则与公正）

collocations.phrase: back down in the face of ...
collocations.example: History rarely remembers those who backed down in the face of difficulty; it keeps its brightest pages for those who pressed on. （议论文·勇气与坚持）

collocations.phrase: show no sign of backing down
collocations.example: Both sides in the debate showed no sign of backing down, so the chairperson wisely called for a five-minute break to let tempers cool. （应用文/读后续写·辩论场景）
Quiet as she was, Susan was never one to back down without a fight when the school library's opening hours were at stake. （读后续写·人物刻画）

synonyms.example: After a week of my begging, Dad finally gave in and agreed to adopt the shivering stray dog from the shelter. （读后续写·家庭温情）
synonyms.usage: 最常用的'屈服',强调最终顺从压力或恳求,常接 to;back down 特指在对峙中收回自己的立场

synonyms.example: With grace rare for his age, the young chess player conceded defeat and reached across the board to shake his opponent's hand. （读后续写·体育精神）
synonyms.usage: 正式用语,多用于辩论、比赛,指承认对方正确或自己失利(concede defeat / a point)

synonyms.example: A true scientist yields to evidence, not to authority — a principle that has carried human knowledge across every frontier. （议论文·科学精神）
synonyms.usage: 书面正式,yield to pressure/temptation;另有'出产、让出'等义,注意语境

synonyms.example: Realizing the figures proved him wrong, the councillor was forced to climb down and apologize publicly for his earlier accusation. （议论文/新闻语体）
synonyms.usage: 英式表达,含'被迫放弃原先强硬立场并认错'之意,与 back down 最接近,但更强调'低头认错'

advancedExpressions.expression: Just when ... seemed inevitable, sb backed down, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just when a shouting match seemed inevitable, Tom backed down, loosening his clenched fists — some victories, he realized, are won by walking away. （just when 悬念句+动作细节 clenched fists+破折号哲理收尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: Knowing when to back down and when to stand firm is ...
advancedExpressions.example: Knowing when to back down and when to stand firm is a lesson no textbook teaches, yet it will serve you in every friendship you ever build. （动名词平行结构作主语,对照式建议,适合建议信总结段）

advancedExpressions.expression: Backing down is not ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: Backing down in a heated moment is not surrender but strategy: the argument you refuse to win today may save the relationship you cannot afford to lose. （not...but 对照+冒号解释+对仗句式,辩证段落核心句）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He didn't back down even though everyone was against him.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Even with the whole room against him, he would not back down; chin lifted and voice steady, he repeated his point once more, each word planted like a flag on ground he refused to give up. （读后续写·人物气节·动作描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: even with 让步状语 + 独立主格(chin lifted and voice steady) + 明喻(like a flag) + refuse to give up 呼应 back down 强化主题

sentenceUpgrade.original: Sometimes we should back down in an argument.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my belief that backing down at the right moment, far from damaging one's dignity, actually reflects a maturity that no amount of shouting can ever achieve. （议论文·修养与沟通）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my belief that 正式主句 + far from 插入语先破后立 + no amount of...can ever 强调结构

translation: 正常的，一般的；常态，通常标准
sub_section: Article: Strangers under the same roof?
original_sentence: Just remember that it is completely normal to struggle with the stress that parent‑child tensions create, and that you and your parents can work together to improve your relationship.
readingExamples: Just remember that it is completely normal to struggle with the stress that parent‑child tensions create, and that you and your parents can work together to improve your relationship.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. usual, typical or expected; not strange, special or different
(2) adj. (of a person) physically and mentally healthy; behaving or developing in the way most people do
(3) n. the usual state, level or standard (e.g. above / below normal; return to normal)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 师范的(normal school / university 师范学校 / 大学,源自法语 école normale,意为确立教学'规范'的学校)
uncommonMeanings.example: To the whole village, the girl who had won a place at Beijing Normal University was more than a student — she was a promise that their children, too, would one day have a teacher of their own. （读后续写·乡村教育·梦想传承）

posExamples.sentence: "It is perfectly normal to feel nervous before your first performance," Miss Lin whispered, pressing the trembling bow back into my hands, her smile steadier than any spotlight in the hall. （读后续写·师生鼓励·细节描写）

Life in the flooded town crept slowly back to normal: shops reopened one by one, children's laughter returned to the square, and only the watermark on the walls still remembered the fear. （读后续写·灾后重建·环境描写）
Please note that the school library will return to its normal opening hours next Monday, and all borrowed books should be returned to the front desk before the end of this month. （应用文·通知）
In an age when photo-editing apps make flawless faces seem normal, young people need reminding that real beauty lies in what makes each of us different, not identical. （议论文·审美与自信）

wordForms.verb: normalize 使正常化,使常态化

idioms.example: Online classes, once an emergency measure, have quietly become the new normal, reshaping not only how we learn but also how much we treasure a real classroom. （议论文·教育变革）

collocations.example: Just remember that it is completely normal to miss home during your first weeks abroad; homesickness is simply love with nowhere familiar to go. （应用文·安慰信/建议信）

collocations.phrase: it is normal (for sb) to do sth
collocations.example: It is normal for teenagers to disagree with their parents now and then, but slamming the door turns a small difference into a deep divide. （议论文/应用文·亲子关系）
Three days after the snowstorm, traffic finally got back to normal, and the city stretched itself awake like a cat after a long sleep. （读后续写·环境描写）
Under normal circumstances, the museum closes at five, but during the Culture Week it will stay open until nine for evening visitors. （应用文·通知）

collocations.translation: 正常的生活 / 日常安排
collocations.example: Thanks to the operation funded by our charity sale, the little boy can now lead a normal life, running and laughing with his classmates at last. （应用文·活动成果报道）

collocations.translation: 高于 / 低于正常水平
collocations.example: With temperatures this July climbing well above normal, the community centre has opened its air-conditioned hall to elderly residents free of charge. （应用文·通知/报道）
Though his world had quietly fallen apart that morning, Mr. Brown greeted his students as normal, saving his tears for the empty staffroom. （读后续写·隐忍·人物描写）

synonyms.example: It was an ordinary Tuesday afternoon until a paper crane sailed through the window and landed on my desk, a message folded in its wing. （读后续写·平凡中的转折）
synonyms.usage: 强调'平凡、无特别之处',可带'不出众'的意味;normal 强调'符合常态或标准',反义是 abnormal 而非 special

synonyms.example: Doctors agree that regular exercise and a fixed sleep schedule do more for teenagers' concentration than any amount of coffee. （议论文·健康作息）
synonyms.usage: 强调'定期、有规律'(regular exercise/check-ups),侧重频率;normal 侧重状态是否正常

synonyms.example: A typical school day for me begins with morning reading at seven and ends with the evening self-study bell at ten. （应用文·介绍信）
synonyms.usage: 强调'具有代表性,能反映一类事物的特点'(be typical of);normal 只说'不异常',不含代表性

synonyms.example: For an average student like me, what changed everything was not talent but a teacher who refused to believe I was average. （议论文/夹叙夹议·教育的力量）
synonyms.usage: 统计意义上的'中等水平',形容人时常含'平庸'的贬义;normal 为中性描述

advancedExpressions.expression: It is completely normal to ..., I reminded myself, ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is completely normal to stumble at the start, I reminded myself, loosening my grip on the handlebars — even the wind had to learn which way to blow. （自我对话式心理描写+动作细节+拟人化比喻,缓解紧张场景）

advancedExpressions.expression: With everything back to normal, ...
advancedExpressions.example: With everything back to normal after the renovation, the reading room reopens this Friday, and we warmly welcome you to its brighter lamps and quieter corners. （with 复合结构开篇交代背景+具体细节增强画面,通知类高分开头）

advancedExpressions.expression: What was once ... has become the new normal, which ...
advancedExpressions.example: What was once a luxury — ordering dinner with one tap — has become the new normal, which obliges us to ask what conveniences are quietly costing us. （what 主语从句+破折号插入+which 从句引出反思,现象评论型议论文首段句式）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Everything went back to normal after the exam.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: After the exam, life folded itself back to normal — the playground refilled with shouts, the late-night lamps went out one by one — yet something in me, stretched by those hard months, refused to shrink to its old size. （读后续写·成长感悟）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟人(life folded itself) + 破折号内双画面列举 + yet 转折点出成长 + stretched/shrink 意象呼应

sentenceUpgrade.original: It is normal for students to feel stressed.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: That students should feel stressed under academic pressure is entirely normal; what truly matters is whether we treat stress as a wall that blocks us or a stair that lifts us. （议论文·压力观）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: that 从句作主语正式化 + 分号衔接递进 + wall/stair 双重隐喻对照收尾

translation: 精神压力，紧张；强调，着重
sub_section: Article: Strangers under the same roof?
original_sentence: Just remember that it is completely normal to struggle with the stress that parent‑child tensions create, and that you and your parents can work together to improve your relationship.
readingExamples: Just remember that it is completely normal to struggle with the stress that parent‑child tensions create, and that you and your parents can work together to improve your relationship.
definitionEn:
(1) n. continuous feelings of worry and tension caused by pressure in your life, work or study
(2) n. special emphasis or importance given to something
(3) n. the extra force used when pronouncing a particular syllable or word; (physics) the pressure or force acting on an object
(4) vt. to emphasize a point, fact, etc.; to pronounce a syllable with extra force; (stress sb out) to make someone extremely anxious and tense

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 重音(语音学,高考听力/语音题常考)
uncommonMeanings.example: "The stress falls on the second syllable," the coach repeated patiently, and on the hundredth attempt the stubborn word finally rolled off Amy's tongue as naturally as her own name. （读后续写·口语训练·坚持）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (物理)应力,(物体承受的)压力
uncommonMeanings.example: The engineer explained that the century-old bridge had been under constant stress for decades, which was why every loaded truck now had to be weighed before crossing. （读后续写/说明文·科普场景）

posExamples.sentence: The week before the final exam, stress wrapped around me like a tightening rope, until Dad's crumpled note in my lunchbox — "Just do your best" — loosened it with five small words. （读后续写·考试压力·亲情细节）
Our Student Union will hold a lecture on managing stress this Friday afternoon, where a psychologist will share practical tips on breathing exercises, time planning and positive self-talk. （应用文·通知）
Psychologists stress that moderate pressure sharpens the mind, but once stress outweighs our ability to cope, it stops being a motivator and starts being a destroyer. （议论文·压力的辩证观）
I must stress that all entries for the photography competition should be original works taken by yourselves, as any copied or AI-generated image will lead to immediate disqualification. （应用文·比赛启事）

wordForms.adjective: stressful(令人紧张的);stressed / stressed-out(感到压力大的)

idioms.idiom: lay / place / put stress on sth
idioms.example: Our school lays great stress on all-round development, which explains why the timetable finds room for pottery and stargazing alongside physics and maths. （应用文·学校介绍）

collocations.example: Noticing that his desk-mate had been under great stress lately, Wang Lei quietly slipped an encouraging bookmark into her heaviest textbook. （读后续写·同窗情谊·细节动作）
A brisk walk around the playground after dinner, our monitor suggested, is the cheapest and quickest way to relieve stress before evening classes. （应用文·建议）
Learning to cope with stress is itself a subject never printed on any timetable, yet it decides how well we perform in all the others. （议论文·心理素质）
For many senior students, the constant comparison with "other people's children" is a greater source of stress than the exams themselves. （议论文·教育反思）

collocations.translation: 考试压力 / 工作压力
collocations.example: The survey shows that exam stress peaks in the final term, which is precisely when our school's counselling room sees the fewest visitors — a gap worth closing. （应用文·调查报告）

collocations.phrase: stress the importance / need of / for
collocations.translation: 强调……的重要性 / 必要性
collocations.example: In his opening speech, the headmaster stressed the importance of honesty, reminding us that a mark gained by cheating is a loss wearing the mask of a win. （应用文/读后续写·校园演讲）
The stress management workshop turned out to be surprisingly popular, with students queuing at the door long before the psychologist arrived. （应用文·活动报道）

collocations.phrase: stress sb out / be stressed out
collocations.translation: 使某人焦虑不堪;压力过大
collocations.example: Rather than admit the endless drills were stressing her out, Lucy kept smiling in class — until her diary, found open on her desk, told the truth for her. （读后续写·心理刻画·伏笔）

synonyms.example: Under the pressure of the coming deadline, the whole team worked shoulder to shoulder deep into the night, fuelled by instant noodles and a shared dream. （读后续写·团队奋斗）
synonyms.usage: 侧重来自外部的压力(时间、期望、竞争),under pressure;stress 侧重压力造成的内心紧张状态

synonyms.example: Years of night shifts had put a visible strain on Father's health, though he always waved away our concern with the same tired smile. （读后续写·父爱·细节描写）
synonyms.usage: 强调长期负荷带来的损耗,可用于身体、关系、财政(put a strain on);stress 更侧重心理感受

synonyms.example: The tension between the two old friends melted the instant one of them held out the friendship bracelet they had woven in primary school. （读后续写·和解场面）
synonyms.usage: 多指人与人、局势之间的紧张关系或气氛,正呼应课文中的 parent-child tensions;也指肌肉紧绷

synonyms.example: The guide emphasized that no flash photography was allowed in the cave, for the ancient paintings were as fragile as sleeping butterflies. （读后续写/应用文·参观规则）
synonyms.usage: 与动词 stress 基本同义且可互换,emphasize 使用频率更高;二者皆可接名词或 that 从句

advancedExpressions.expression: All the stress that had been building up ... melted away as ...
advancedExpressions.example: All the stress that had been building up for months melted away as I crossed the finish line, and the cheers washed over me like warm rain. （定语从句蓄势+melt away 情绪释放+明喻收尾,续写高潮段情感宣泄模板）

advancedExpressions.expression: What must be stressed is that ...
advancedExpressions.example: What must be stressed is that participation matters more than prizes: every runner who completes the charity race lights one more lamp for the children in the mountains. （what 主语从句突出强调+冒号具体化+隐喻式感召,倡议书核心句）

advancedExpressions.expression: Rather than viewing stress as ..., we would be wiser to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Rather than viewing stress as an enemy to be eliminated, we would be wiser to treat it as a coach whose harsh whistle, in the end, makes us run faster. （rather than 先破后立+enemy/coach 隐喻对照,辩证段落框架）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She felt a lot of stress before the exam.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The night before the exam, stress sat on her chest like an uninvited guest who refused to leave, rearranging her breathing, her heartbeat, even the order of the formulas in her head. （读后续写·心理描写·具象化）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 压力拟人化(sat on her chest like an uninvited guest) + who 定语从句延伸比喻 + 三项递进列举(breathing, heartbeat, formulas)放大焦虑

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should learn to deal with stress.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is high time we stopped wearing stress as a badge of diligence and started managing it as a skill, for a mind stretched taut without rest will snap rather than spring. （议论文·压力管理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is high time + 过去式虚拟 + stopped...started 对照结构 + badge of diligence 隐喻 + snap/spring 头韵式对比收尾

sub_section: B1 邮件填空
original_sentence: Dear Editor, I am writing to ask for advice on my relationship with my teenage son.
readingExamples: Dear Editor, I am writing to ask for advice on my relationship with my teenage son.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a person who is in charge of a newspaper, magazine, or a section of it, and decides what should be included
(2) n. a person whose job is to correct and prepare a piece of writing, film, or programme before it is published or shown
(3) n. a computer program that allows you to change, add to, or organise text or code

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (影视)剪辑师
uncommonMeanings.example: For three sleepless nights the editor sat hunched over the screen, splicing together fragments of laughter and tears until a scattered pile of footage finally breathed as a single, living story. （读后续写·幕后工作者·匠心）

posExamples.sentence: The old editor peered over his glasses at the trembling intern, then, to her astonishment, circled her headline in red and murmured, 'This — this is the sentence that will make readers stop and think.' （读后续写·师徒·鼓励）
Dear Editor, I am writing to draw your attention to the growing problem of food waste in our school canteen, and to propose several practical measures your newspaper might champion. （应用文·投稿信/读者来信）
A responsible editor does far more than polish grammar; by deciding which voices reach the public, he or she quietly shapes what an entire generation comes to believe is worth knowing. （议论文·媒体与责任）

collocations.example: At only twenty-eight, she was appointed editor-in-chief, the youngest in the magazine's century-long history. （读后续写·励志·破格）
As the editor of our school magazine, I sincerely invite every student to submit their original stories and poems. （应用文·征稿启事）
Her passionate letter to the editor sparked a city-wide debate on protecting the old library. （议论文·舆论力量）
Under the patient guidance of a senior editor, the young writer learned to cut a beloved paragraph for the sake of the whole. （读后续写·成长）
The film editor's clever cut between the child's smile and the falling rain moved the whole audience to tears. （读后续写·电影·情感）
The photo editor selected a single haunting image that said more than a thousand words of report. （应用文·新闻）
A great book is rarely the work of one person; behind every author stands an editor who saw its potential first. （议论文·合作）

synonyms.example: The reviewer praised the essay's structure but suggested the argument in paragraph three needed sharper evidence. （议论文·学术）
synonyms.usage: 侧重对内容质量的评判与反馈，多用于学术论文/书评，不一定负责删改定稿；editor 则掌握出版决定权并动手修改。

synonyms.example: As the compiler of the anthology, she spent two years gathering forgotten poems from dusty village archives. （读后续写·文化·坚守）
synonyms.usage: 侧重把分散材料收集整理成集，强调'汇编'动作；editor 更强调审校、把关与最终定稿的权力。

advancedExpressions.expression: with the practised eye of an editor, sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: With the practised eye of an editor, the old man scanned the page and, without a word, drew a single line that transformed the whole essay. （比喻式后置状语，用职业眼光凸显专业与从容）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to the editor in the hope that ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing to the editor in the hope that these pages will give voice to the many students who feel unheard. （读者来信固定开头，点明写作目的）

advancedExpressions.expression: in the hands of a conscientious editor, ... becomes ...
advancedExpressions.example: In the hands of a conscientious editor, a raw flood of information becomes a clear stream of understanding. （介词短语开头 + 隐喻，突出编辑的把关价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The editor read my story and liked it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The editor read my story in a single, unbroken silence; then he set the pages down, looked at me for a long moment, and said quietly, 'You have something here that cannot be taught.' （读后续写·对话+悬念）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 以'unbroken silence'制造悬念 + 一连串动作(set down/looked/said)推进节奏 + 直接引语作情感高潮

sentenceUpgrade.original: An editor is important to a newspaper.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is no exaggeration to say that an editor is the conscience of a newspaper, for it is he who decides not merely what is printed, but what an entire community will come to regard as the truth. （议论文·观点强化）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is no exaggeration to say that...加强论断 + for引导原因 + it is he who强调句 + not merely...but递进

translation: 争吵，争辩，争论；说理，论证
sub_section: B1 邮件填空
original_sentence: Recently we have argued with each other a great deal.
readingExamples: Recently we have argued with each other a great deal.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to speak angrily to someone because you disagree with them; to quarrel
(2) v. to give reasons why you think something is right or true, especially to persuade others
(3) v. to state or show clearly the reasons for or against something
(4) v. to prove or suggest that something is true (formal, esp. of facts or evidence)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 表明，证明（某事物是……）；说明
uncommonMeanings.example: The abandoned toys and the still-warm cup of tea argued a hasty, frightened departure — someone had fled this house in the middle of an ordinary afternoon. （读后续写·悬疑·环境暗示）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 说服（某人做/不做某事）—— argue sb. into / out of
uncommonMeanings.example: No matter how his friends argued him out of it, the boy remained determined to search the mountain for his lost dog alone. （读后续写·人物·倔强）

posExamples.sentence: For weeks my mother and I had argued over the smallest things, until one rainy evening she simply sat down beside me and, in a trembling voice, asked, 'When did we stop talking?' （读后续写·亲情·和解）
I am writing to argue that our school should extend the opening hours of the library, as many students struggle to find a quiet place to study after class. （应用文·建议信）
Some people argue that failure is merely the absence of success; I would argue instead that failure is the very soil in which lasting success takes root. （议论文·观点交锋）
It is pointless to argue with a person who refuses to listen, for reason cannot enter a mind that has bolted its doors. （议论文·处世·比喻）

idioms.translation: （对已定之事）争论不休，为已成定局的事强辩（非正式）
idioms.example: The decision had been made and there was no point arguing the toss; grumbling, he picked up his bag and left. （读后续写·不甘·让步）

collocations.example: That night, instead of arguing with my brother over the remote as usual, I switched off the TV and asked how his exams had gone. （读后续写·亲情·转变）
The scientist argued that even small daily choices, multiplied across billions of people, could reshape the planet's future. （议论文·环保）
In the debate, our team argued for a shorter school day, insisting that rested minds learn faster than exhausted ones. （应用文·辩论/演讲）

collocations.phrase: argue sb into / out of (doing) sth
collocations.example: Nothing anyone said could argue her out of chasing a career the whole village thought was foolish. （读后续写·追梦·坚定）
She stood before the committee and argued the case for the new recycling scheme so convincingly that not a single hand rose in objection. （应用文·提案）
For once the boy did not argue back; he simply lowered his eyes, and in that silence his father saw that he had finally understood. （读后续写·父子·成长）
It could be argued that hardship, far from crushing us, is what teaches us the true measure of our strength. （议论文·委婉论断）
Looking back, I am ashamed that we once argued over trifles while the years we could have shared slipped quietly away. （读后续写·悔悟）

synonyms.example: The two sisters quarrelled bitterly at breakfast, and neither dared to be the first to say sorry. （读后续写·家庭·矛盾）
synonyms.usage: 专指带愤怒情绪的口角、吵架，语气比 argue 更激烈、更私人化；argue 既可指吵架，也可指心平气和地说理论证。

synonyms.example: The class debated whether social media does more harm than good, each side marshalling facts and figures. （议论文·辩论）
synonyms.usage: 指有规则、有条理的正式辩论或公开讨论，中性、理性；argue 更口语，可指日常争吵，也可指个人提出主张。

synonyms.example: The historian contended that this single letter had changed the course of the war. （议论文·学术·书面）
synonyms.usage: 非常正式、书面，强调在争议中坚定地提出并坚持某主张；作'主张'讲时可替换 argue that，但语域更高。

synonyms.example: She tried to reason with the frightened child, kneeling to his level and speaking in the softest of voices. （读后续写·安抚）
synonyms.usage: 侧重用逻辑冷静地推理或耐心劝说，含'讲道理'的温和意味；argue 更可能带对抗或坚持己见的色彩。

advancedExpressions.expression: the words we had argued over ... suddenly seemed ...
advancedExpressions.example: The angry words we had argued over all week suddenly seemed unbearably small beside the sight of her tears. （用今昔对比让'争吵'的琐碎在情感冲击前崩塌，推动和解）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would argue that ..., not only because ... but also because ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would argue that reading aloud benefits us greatly, not only because it improves our pronunciation but also because it deepens our understanding of the text. （建议信论证句，双重理由更有说服力）

advancedExpressions.expression: some argue that ...; I would argue, however, that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Some argue that talent decides everything; I would argue, however, that it is persistence, not talent, that carries us across the finish line. （先让步引出对立观点，再用however强势反转，结构鲜明）

sentenceUpgrade.original: My father and I often argued.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: For as long as I could remember, my father and I had argued like two storms determined to occupy the same sky — until the day his illness taught us both how little those quarrels had ever truly mattered. （读后续写·父子·顿悟）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 明喻(two storms...same sky)将争吵形象化 + until引导转折点 + 尾句以'how little...mattered'完成情感升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: People argue that money brings happiness.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: While many argue that money is the surest road to happiness, a closer look at the restless faces of the wealthy suggests that contentment is a treasure no fortune can simply purchase. （议论文·先让步后反驳）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: While引导让步状语 + 'a closer look...suggests'客观化论证 + 结尾用'no fortune can purchase'的隐喻收束观点

sub_section: B1 邮件填空
original_sentence: He is anxious about his skin because it has started to become very oily, with lots of red spots.
readingExamples: He is anxious about his skin because it has started to become very oily, with lots of red spots.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the natural outer layer that covers a person's or animal's body
(2) n. the skin of a dead animal, used to make leather, clothing, etc.; a hide or pelt
(3) n. the thin outer covering of some fruits and vegetables; a peel
(4) n. a thin solid layer that forms on the surface of a liquid, e.g. on cooling milk or paint

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （液体表面结的）薄皮、薄膜
uncommonMeanings.example: By the time she returned, the cocoa had gone cold and a wrinkled skin had formed on its surface — a small, silent proof of how long she had kept him waiting. （读后续写·细节·愧疚）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 擦破（皮）；给……剥皮
uncommonMeanings.example: He skinned his knee against the rough bark as he scrambled up the tree, yet he did not even flinch, his eyes fixed on the trapped kitten above. （读后续写·勇敢·救援）

posExamples.sentence: Years of harsh sun and salt wind had weathered the fisherman's skin into a map of deep brown lines, each wrinkle telling a story of storms survived. （读后续写·人物·沧桑）
To protect our skin from the summer sun, I strongly suggest that every classmate wear a hat and apply sunscreen before the outdoor sports meeting. （应用文·健康提醒/通知）
True beauty, as the saying goes, is more than skin deep; a kind heart outlasts a fair complexion long after youth has faded. （议论文·内在与外表）

wordForms.other: skin-deep (adj. 肤浅的) / skincare (n. 护肤)

idioms.translation: 不只是表面的，是深层的（常指美丽、善良）
idioms.example: Her kindness was more than skin deep; it showed in the way she stopped for every stray dog on the road home. （读后续写·品格）

idioms.translation: 保住性命，使自己免遭伤害
idioms.example: He could have fled to save his own skin, but instead he turned back into the smoke to drag his neighbour to safety. （读后续写·舍己）

idioms.translation: 使某人恼火；令人着迷、萦绕心头
idioms.example: The stranger's quiet confidence got under her skin, and long after he had left, his words still echoed in her mind. （读后续写·心理）

idioms.idiom: by the skin of one's teeth
idioms.example: We caught the last bus by the skin of our teeth, collapsing into our seats just as the doors hissed shut. （读后续写·惊险）

idioms.translation: 脸皮厚，不易受伤 / 脸皮薄，易受伤
idioms.example: To survive years of rejection, a young writer must grow a thick skin and learn to see criticism as a gift. （议论文·成长）

collocations.example: The doctor gently explained that his oily skin and red spots were simply a normal part of growing up. （读后续写·青春期·安慰）
Her fair skin flushed a deep crimson the moment the teacher praised her essay before the whole class. （读后续写·害羞）
We should protect our skin from strong sunlight, especially during long hours of outdoor training. （应用文·健康建议）
In our club, no one is judged by skin colour or background; what unites us is a shared love of music. （议论文·平等）
For all their arguing, the two rivals were, under the skin, remarkably alike. （读后续写·人物）
The hunters of old wrapped themselves in animal skins to survive the merciless northern winter. （读后续写·历史·生存）
She peeled the skin from the apple in one long, unbroken ribbon, a small trick her grandmother had taught her years ago. （读后续写·温情·回忆）
The sudden downpour soaked us to the skin, yet we laughed all the way home, splashing through every puddle. （读后续写·雨中·欢乐）

synonyms.example: Sleepless nights had robbed her once-glowing complexion of all its colour. （读后续写·憔悴）
synonyms.usage: 专指脸部皮肤的颜色和状态（气色），带有对外貌的审美评价；skin 泛指全身的皮肤组织本身，范围更广、更中性。

synonyms.example: The tanner soaked the ox hide for days before it could be turned into sturdy leather. （读后续写·手艺·传统）
synonyms.usage: 特指大型动物（牛、马等）加工用的厚兽皮，多用于制革语境；skin 既可指人也可指动物的皮，且可指较薄的皮。

synonyms.example: The kitchen smelled of oranges, their bright peel curling in a bowl by the window. （读后续写·生活气息）
synonyms.usage: 特指可剥下的水果、蔬菜外皮，日常烹饪常用；skin 用于果皮时更强调紧贴果肉的那层，语气略正式。

advancedExpressions.expression: beneath the calm surface of her skin, ... was ...
advancedExpressions.example: Beneath the calm surface of her skin, a storm of fear and hope was quietly raging. （用皮肤的'平静'反衬内心的波澜，外静内动的对比技法）

advancedExpressions.expression: for the sake of our skin and health, may I suggest that ...
advancedExpressions.example: For the sake of our skin and long-term health, may I suggest that we all limit our time under the midday sun. （倡议句式，先讲缘由再委婉建议）

advancedExpressions.expression: what lies beneath the skin matters far more than ...
advancedExpressions.example: In the end, what lies beneath the skin — courage, kindness, integrity — matters far more than any face the mirror shows us. （破折号列举内在品质，深化'内在胜于外表'的论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The rain made us very wet.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The rain came down without warning and soaked us to the skin in seconds, yet not one of us thought to complain — we simply threw back our heads and let the sky wash away a whole term's worth of worry. （读后续写·雨中·释放）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 习语'soaked to the skin'替代'very wet' + 转折yet制造情绪反差 + 尾句夸张比喻(wash away worry)升华意境

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should not judge people by their looks.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: If life has taught me anything, it is that a person's worth runs far deeper than skin; the plainest face may hide the bravest heart, and the fairest smile the coldest soul. （议论文·内外对照）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: If life has taught me anything...强调句式开头 + 'deeper than skin'双关(字面/比喻) + 对偶(plainest face/fairest smile)增强论证张力

sub_section: A 句子类型探究
original_sentence: So, we have designed TeenHealthWeb to help you along the journey to adulthood.
readingExamples: So, we have designed TeenHealthWeb to help you along the journey to adulthood.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to plan and make drawings of how something will be built, made, or how it will work
(2) v. to plan or develop something for a specific purpose or use
(3) n. the way in which something is planned and made, or its arrangement of parts
(4) n. a drawing or plan showing how something is to be made; the art or process of designing

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 意图，图谋，蓄意（常用复数 designs，或短语 by design）
uncommonMeanings.example: It was not by chance but by design that he had sat beside her that evening; every word, every pause, had been quietly rehearsed for weeks. （读后续写·心机·反转）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （对某人/某物的）不良企图 —— have designs on sb / sth
uncommonMeanings.example: The villagers whispered that the stranger had designs on the old widow's land, though he smiled at them as sweetly as ever. （读后续写·悬疑·人心）

posExamples.sentence: Working late into the night, the young engineer designed a simple hand-powered pump that would one day bring clean water to her drought-stricken village. （读后续写·梦想·奉献）
Our art club has designed a series of eco-friendly posters, and we sincerely hope you will display them around the campus to raise environmental awareness. （应用文·活动信）
A truly great city is never the product of chance; behind its harmony of streets and parks lies a bold design that balances beauty with the needs of ordinary lives. （议论文·城市/规划）
The dress was plain in colour yet daring in design, and the moment she stepped into the hall, every conversation faltered into silence. （读后续写·出场·惊艳）

wordForms.other: designedly (adv. 蓄意地) / by design (故意地)

idioms.translation: 故意地，蓄意地（反义: by accident/chance）
idioms.example: Whether by design or by luck, his careless remark landed exactly where it hurt her most. （读后续写·人物·耐人寻味）

idioms.translation: 对某人/某物心怀企图（多含贬义）
idioms.example: Everyone could see that the ambitious clerk had designs on the manager's position. （读后续写·职场）

collocations.phrase: design sth for / to do sth
collocations.translation: 为……而设计；设计……以做某事
collocations.example: So, we have designed TeenHealthWeb to help you along the journey to adulthood. （应用文·网站介绍·教材原句）

collocations.translation: 旨在做某事，专为……而设计
collocations.example: The whole programme is designed to help shy students find their voice and speak with confidence. （应用文·活动介绍）
Ever since she was a child, she had dreamed of studying fashion design in a city where creativity never sleeps. （读后续写·追梦）

collocations.translation: 大胆的/巧妙的/简洁的设计
collocations.example: The bridge's clever design allowed it to sway with the wind rather than break against it. （议论文·科技/智慧）
The design of the new library, with its walls of glass and rivers of light, seemed to invite the whole city inside. （读后续写·环境描写）
The students were asked to design and build a model bridge using nothing but paper and glue. （应用文·活动/竞赛）
A well-designed lesson feels less like a lecture and more like a journey the learner cannot wait to continue. （议论文·教育）

collocations.translation: 制订计划／设计实验／设计问卷
collocations.example: To find out how classmates spend their free time, our group carefully designed a questionnaire and handed it out at lunch. （应用文·调查报告）

synonyms.example: For months he planned every detail of the surprise, from the flowers to the very song that would be playing. （读后续写·用心）
synonyms.usage: 泛指为达成目标而作的安排、方案，范围最广；design 更强调对形式、结构、外观的创造性构思，常涉及绘图或美学。

synonyms.example: The trapped miners devised an ingenious way to signal the rescuers far above. （读后续写·绝境·智慧）
synonyms.usage: 强调开动脑筋'想出'巧妙的办法、系统或计谋，重在构思过程；design 更侧重把构思落成图纸或成品，含制作意味。

synonyms.example: With a few scraps of cloth and endless patience, the old tailor created a coat fit for a king. （读后续写·匠人）
synonyms.usage: 泛指从无到有地创造，情感与艺术色彩更浓；design 特指有目的、有计划地构思结构与外形，更理性、更工程化。

advancedExpressions.expression: it was not by chance but by design that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was not by chance but by design that their paths crossed again that autumn. （by chance与by design对照，为情节埋下伏笔，暗示背后有意安排）

advancedExpressions.expression: we have designed ... to help / enable ... to do sth
advancedExpressions.example: We have designed this reading week to help every student rediscover the simple joy of turning a page. （介绍活动宗旨的黄金句式，目的清晰）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... is not an accident but the result of careful design
advancedExpressions.example: A prosperous society is not an accident but the result of careful design — of laws, of schools, and of a shared vision patiently pursued. （否定+肯定结构强调'人为规划'，破折号列举支撑）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She designed a website to help teenagers.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Late at night, long after the others had gone home, she quietly designed a website where lonely teenagers could pour out their fears to strangers who would never judge them. （读后续写·奉献·画面感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语(Late at night...gone home)营造孤独专注的氛围 + where定语从句拓展网站意义 + 'pour out their fears'情感动词提升温度

sentenceUpgrade.original: The system was designed well, so it worked.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Because the system had been designed with such foresight — every part anticipating the failure of another — it went on running smoothly long after its creators had been forgotten. （议论文·设计的智慧）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Because引导原因状语提前 + 破折号插入语解释'foresight' + 'long after...forgotten'时间对比凸显设计的持久价值

translation: 论坛，讨论会；公共集会场所
sub_section: A 句子类型探究
original_sentence: You can visit the "teen health" forum on our website instead.
readingExamples: You can visit the "teen health" forum on our website instead.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a place, meeting, or medium where people can exchange opinions and ideas on a particular issue
(2) n. a website or online discussion group where people can post messages and share views
(3) n. (in ancient Rome) a public square or marketplace used for public business and assemblies

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （古罗马的）广场，公共集会场所
uncommonMeanings.example: In the crumbling forum, where senators had once thundered and crowds had once roared, only the wind now moved among the broken pillars. （读后续写·历史·沧桑）

posExamples.sentence: Too nervous to speak of his troubles aloud, the boy poured them into an anonymous online forum one sleepless night — and by morning, a stranger's gentle reply had made him feel a little less alone. （读后续写·青春·陪伴）
You can visit the "teen health" forum on our website, where you may post any question and receive friendly advice from both experts and fellow students. （应用文·网站介绍·教材延伸）
A healthy society needs open forums where every voice, however humble, can be heard; silence the discussion, and you silence progress itself. （议论文·言论/民主）

collocations.example: She had never met the people on that online forum, yet over the years they had become the truest friends she knew. （读后续写·网络·真情）
Our school has set up a discussion forum where students can freely share study tips and exam experiences. （应用文·校园通知）

collocations.translation: 公共论坛，公开讨论的场合
collocations.example: The town hall became a public forum in which farmers and officials, for the first time, spoke to one another as equals. （议论文·公共事务）

collocations.phrase: provide / offer a forum for sth
collocations.example: The website provides a forum for young writers to share their stories and encourage one another. （应用文·平台介绍）
The moment she posted her question on the forum, a dozen helpful replies began to appear. （读后续写·细节）
The teacher turned the last lesson into an open forum, inviting every student to voice what school had truly meant to them. （读后续写·校园·告别）
Such conferences serve as a valuable forum for the exchange of ideas across cultures. （议论文·国际交流）

synonyms.translation: 平台；讲台，机会（发表意见的场合）
synonyms.example: The competition gave the shy girl a platform to show a talent no one had ever suspected. （读后续写·机会）
synonyms.usage: 既可指发表言论的机会/舞台（抽象），也可指网络平台；forum 更强调多方'交流讨论'的场所或渠道，双向互动色彩更浓。

synonyms.translation: 会议，研讨会（正式的大型集会）
synonyms.example: Scholars from thirty countries gathered at the conference to debate the future of clean energy. （议论文·学术）
synonyms.usage: 指有组织、有议程的正式大型会议，规模大、层级高；forum 可以是会议，也可以是网站或日常讨论场合，形式更灵活、更开放。

synonyms.example: A panel of experts answered students' questions on stress and mental health. （应用文·活动）
synonyms.usage: 特指由若干专家组成、当众讨论或答疑的'小组'；forum 侧重供大众参与交流的整个场合或平台，参与者不限于专家。

advancedExpressions.expression: in an anonymous forum, sb. finally dared to ...
advancedExpressions.example: In an anonymous forum, hidden behind a nameless screen, she finally dared to say the words she could never speak aloud. （'anonymous forum'的匿名感解释人物为何敢于袒露，合理推动心理转变）

advancedExpressions.expression: our forum offers a space where you can ...
advancedExpressions.example: Our forum offers a warm space where you can ask any question freely and always find someone ready to help. （介绍平台功能的推介句式，突出'安全、友好'）

advancedExpressions.expression: an open forum is the lifeblood of ...
advancedExpressions.example: An open forum, where ideas may clash without fear, is the very lifeblood of a thinking society. （隐喻lifeblood强调论坛之于社会的根本重要性，插入语补充定义）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She asked a question on a forum and someone helped her.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Alone at her desk past midnight, she typed her question into the forum with trembling fingers; minutes later, a single reply glowed on the screen — 'You are not the only one who feels this way' — and something tight in her chest quietly loosened. （读后续写·孤独·被理解）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间地点状语(Alone...past midnight)烘托孤独 + 直接引语作情感转折点 + 身体感受('something tight...loosened')外化心理变化

sentenceUpgrade.original: Online forums let people share ideas.
