He completed the last lap in record time, collapsing across the line as his teammates rushed to lift him up. （读后续写·团队·胜利）
The gentle waves lapped against the shore all evening, soothing the worried travellers into a peaceful sleep. （读后续写·海边·平静）

collocations.translation: 舔食干净；欣然接受（赞美等）
collocations.example: The young actor lapped up every word of praise, unaware that flattery can be a far greater danger than criticism. （读后续写·成长·警示）

synonyms.example: The racers roared past the grandstand, completing another circuit under the blazing sun. （读后续写·赛车）
synonyms.usage: circuit 更偏书面、正式，指绕赛道或环路的一整圈；lap 是口语和体育报道的常用词，也可指泳池一趟。

synonyms.example: Cold water splashed over the rocks as the children laughed and waded deeper. （读后续写·溪边）
synonyms.usage: splash 指水较剧烈地飞溅、发出较大声响；lap 指水温柔、有节奏地轻拍，声音轻柔。

advancedExpressions.expression: the water lapped ..., as if ...
advancedExpressions.example: The water lapped softly at her feet, as if the sea itself were whispering that everything would be all right. （拟人+as if 从句，用景物暗示情绪回暖）

advancedExpressions.expression: each participant is expected to complete ... laps
advancedExpressions.example: During the charity swim, each participant is expected to complete at least ten laps, with sponsors donating for every length swum. （通知中说明具体安排）

advancedExpressions.expression: life, much like a race, is measured not by a single lap but by ...
advancedExpressions.example: Life, much like a race, is measured not by a single dazzling lap but by the steady endurance that carries us, breath by breath, to the finish. （类比+破折号补充升华主旨）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I put the check in Mama's lap.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Tiptoeing across the creaking floor, I slipped the check gently into Mama's lap, and watched as her weary face softened into a smile brighter than the morning sun. （读后续写·亲情+动作细节）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Tiptoeing 现在分词状语开头 + slip...gently 动词精准化 + 'a smile brighter than the morning sun' 比喻收尾

sentenceUpgrade.original: He ran the last lap and won.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Summoning every last ounce of strength, he tore through the final lap, and as his chest broke the tape, the roar of the crowd told him that months of silent sweat had not been in vain. （读后续写·比赛·胜利）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Summoning...状语开头蓄势 + tore through 强动词 + as 时间从句同步动作 + 'silent sweat' 头韵+隐喻点题

sub_section: Extended reading
original_sentence: Just hand it to the teller.
readingExamples: Just hand it to the teller.
definitionEn:
(1) n. someone who works in a bank and whose job is to receive and pay out money to customers
(2) n. a person who tells something, especially stories; a narrator
(3) n. a person who counts votes, especially in a parliament or at a meeting

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 讲述者，讲故事的人（story-teller）
uncommonMeanings.example: Grandma was a born teller of tales, and one glance from her twinkling eyes could hush a whole roomful of restless children into breathless silence. （读后续写·祖孙·讲故事）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 计票员（会议、议会中）
uncommonMeanings.example: As the teller announced the final count, a hush fell over the hall, and every student leaned forward to learn who would lead them for the coming year. （读后续写·选举·悬念）

posExamples.sentence: Trembling, I handed the tiny slip of paper to the teller, half afraid that my hard-earned savings would somehow vanish the moment they left my grip. （读后续写·成长·第一次存钱）
I am writing to praise a bank teller named Mr. Lin, whose patience and kindness turned an ordinary Monday morning into a memory I shall treasure. （应用文·表扬信）
In an age when machines handle every transaction, one may well ask whether the warm smile of a human teller still holds any value at all. （议论文·科技与人情·设问）
The old teller behind the counter had served three generations of our family, and to us he was far more than a stranger counting coins. （读后续写·社区·情感）

wordForms.adjective: telling (adj. 有力的，说明问题的)

collocations.example: The young bank teller noticed the elderly woman's trembling hands and quietly walked around the counter to help her fill in the form. （读后续写·善意·细节）
Just hand the slip to the teller, Mama had told me, and so I did, clutching my courage as tightly as the paper itself. （读后续写·成长·鼓励）
Every village once had its teller of tales, a keeper of memories who wove the past into words by the flickering firelight. （读后续写·传统·怀旧）
Late at night, the glowing screen of the automatic teller machine was the only light on the deserted street. （读后续写·环境描写·孤独）
The fortune-teller studied his palm for a long moment before whispering a single word that would haunt him for years. （读后续写·悬念·转折）

synonyms.example: The cashier smiled warmly as she handed back the change and wished us a pleasant evening. （应用文·购物）
synonyms.usage: cashier 泛指商店、超市里的收银员，也可指银行出纳；teller 主要指银行柜台的出纳员，词义更专。

synonyms.example: The narrator's calm voice guided listeners gently through the tangled events of the story. （读后续写·叙事）
synonyms.usage: narrator 是文学、影视中正式的'叙述者'；teller（尤其 story-teller）更口语，强调当面讲故事的人。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. was a born teller of ..., whose ... could ...
advancedExpressions.example: She was a born teller of stories, whose gentle voice could turn a rainy afternoon into an adventure across distant lands. （whose 定语从句刻画人物魅力）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to express my heartfelt gratitude to ..., a teller who ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing to express my heartfelt gratitude to a teller who went out of his way to help a stranger in need. （表扬信开门见山点明对象）

advancedExpressions.expression: one may ask whether the human teller still ... in an age of ...
advancedExpressions.example: One may ask whether the human teller still matters in an age of automation, yet warmth and understanding remain services no machine can render. （设问+yet 转折突出观点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I gave the check to the teller.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With my heart pounding against my ribs, I handed the precious check to the teller, and only when she flashed me an encouraging smile did the knot in my stomach finally loosen. （读后续写·成长+心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: With my heart pounding 独立主格开头 + 'the knot in my stomach loosen' 身体隐喻心理 + only when...did 部分倒装强调转折

sentenceUpgrade.original: The teller was very kind to my grandmother.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I shall never forget how the young teller, seeing my grandmother struggle with the unfamiliar form, gently stepped forward and guided her hand as though she were his own kin. （应用文·表扬信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: I shall never forget how 强调难忘 + seeing...现在分词状语 + as though 从句升华人情味

translation: (戏剧等)场；场面，片段；地点，现场；景象，风光
sub_section: C 短剧示例与表演
original_sentence: Act 1, Scene 1 Friday evening.
readingExamples: Act 1, Scene 1 Friday evening.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a part of a play or film in which the action stays in one place for a continuous period of time
(2) n. a view or picture of a place, event, or activity; a particular area of activity
(3) n. the place where an event, especially an accident or crime, happens
(4) n. a loud or angry display of feelings in public; a public argument

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （当众的）吵闹，出洋相，发脾气
uncommonMeanings.example: Rather than make a scene in front of the whole restaurant, she swallowed her anger, folded her napkin, and walked out with quiet dignity. （读后续写·人物·克制）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （事故、犯罪的）现场
uncommonMeanings.example: By the time the officers reached the scene, the only witness left was a shivering dog guarding its fallen master. （读后续写·悬念·现场）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （某一）活动领域，圈子
uncommonMeanings.example: Fresh out of college, she threw herself into the city's vibrant art scene, determined to make a name for herself. （读后续写·追梦·奋斗）

posExamples.sentence: In Act 1, Scene 1, the curtain rises on a dimly lit living room, where a lonely old man sits waiting by a telephone that never rings. （读后续写·戏剧·氛围）
As I climbed the last ridge, a breathtaking scene unfolded before my eyes: golden fields rolling towards a horizon set ablaze by the setting sun. （读后续写·登山·景色）
I would like to invite all members to our photography exhibition, where scenes of our beautiful campus captured through student lenses will be on display. （应用文·邀请函）
Behind every glittering scene of success on the stage lie countless unseen hours of sweat, doubt, and quiet perseverance. （议论文·励志·成功背后）

idioms.example: He wanted so badly to make a scene, but one look at his mother's tired face made him bite back every angry word. （读后续写·情绪·克制）

idioms.translation: 为……做铺垫；描述场景背景
idioms.example: The soft rain and dim streetlights set the scene for the unexpected reunion that would change both their lives. （读后续写·铺垫·转折）
While the star singer took the applause, dozens of volunteers worked tirelessly behind the scenes to make the concert a success. （议论文·团队·默默付出）

idioms.idiom: come on the scene / appear on the scene
idioms.example: Just when all hope seemed lost, a young doctor came on the scene and calmly took charge of the chaos. （读后续写·英雄登场·转折）

collocations.phrase: a scene of a play / film
collocations.example: The final scene of the play left the whole audience in tears, and for a long moment no one dared to clap. （读后续写·戏剧·感人）

collocations.phrase: the scene of the accident / crime
collocations.example: The detective knelt at the scene of the crime, certain that even the smallest clue could unlock the whole mystery. （读后续写·悬疑·侦查）

collocations.translation: 令人叹为观止的／美丽的景象
collocations.example: From the mountaintop we gazed in silence at the breathtaking scene, feeling how small our worries truly were. （读后续写·景色·感悟）
A skilful writer knows how to set the scene so vividly that readers feel the wind on their faces before a word of action is spoken. （议论文·写作技巧）
The doctor advised a change of scene, so the exhausted teacher packed her bags and headed for the quiet seaside town. （读后续写·疗愈·转折）
The firefighters were on the scene within minutes, their bravery turning a night of terror into a story of hope. （读后续写·救援·赞颂）
In just two years she rose from an unknown newcomer to a familiar face on the national music scene. （读后续写·追梦·成就）

collocations.phrase: a scene of chaos / joy / devastation
collocations.translation: 一片混乱／欢乐／破坏的景象
collocations.example: When the rescue team finally arrived, they were met with a scene of devastation that no words could adequately describe. （读后续写·灾难·现场）

synonyms.example: From our hotel window we enjoyed a stunning view of the snow-capped peaks. （应用文·游记）
synonyms.usage: view 侧重从某个位置望出去所见的景色；scene 更强调眼前构成一幅完整画面的场面，可含人物和活动。

synonyms.example: The train wound through valleys of unspoilt scenery all afternoon. （读后续写·旅途）
synonyms.usage: scenery 是不可数名词，泛指某地区连绵的自然风光；scene 是可数名词，指一个具体的场面或画面。

synonyms.example: The sight of the wounded bird struggling to fly tugged at every heart in the room. （读后续写·怜悯）
synonyms.usage: sight 强调映入眼帘、引发情感反应的一幕；scene 更中性，可指电影场景、事故现场等多种场面。

advancedExpressions.expression: a(n) ... scene unfolded before sb.'s eyes
advancedExpressions.example: As the mist lifted, a magnificent scene unfolded before our eyes, and for one timeless moment the whole world seemed to hold its breath. （unfold 使景色如画卷徐徐展开）

advancedExpressions.expression: you are warmly invited to witness scenes of ...
advancedExpressions.example: You are warmly invited to witness scenes of our school's proud history, brought vividly to life in this year's drama festival. （邀请函中制造吸引力）

advancedExpressions.expression: behind every glittering scene of ... lie ...
advancedExpressions.example: Behind every glittering scene of triumph lie the unseen struggles that no spotlight ever reveals. （倒装+对比，揭示成功背后）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I saw a beautiful scene from the mountain.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As I reached the summit, a scene of astonishing beauty unfolded before me: valleys draped in morning mist, and a river winding like a silver ribbon towards the golden dawn. （读后续写·登山+景物描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As 时间状语从句 + unfold before me 动态呈现 + 冒号引出细节 + 'like a silver ribbon' 比喻 + 色彩词(golden)烘托

sentenceUpgrade.original: The play has many good scenes.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: What lingered in my mind long after the final curtain was not any single line of dialogue, but the way each carefully crafted scene wove sorrow and hope into an unforgettable whole. （应用文·观后感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: What 引导主语从句强调 + not...but 对比结构 + 'wove...into' 隐喻 + 三音节形容词(unforgettable)收尾

sub_section: C 短剧示例与表演
original_sentence: The living room of a flat.
readingExamples: The living room of a flat.
definitionEn:
(1) n. (British English) a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a larger building; an apartment
(2) adj. smooth and level, without curves, bumps, or slopes
(3) adj. (of a tyre or ball) having lost air; (of a drink) having lost its bubbles; (of a battery) having lost its power
(4) adj. (of a voice, colour, or feeling) dull, lacking energy, interest, or emotion

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （轮胎）瘪了的，没气的
uncommonMeanings.example: Halfway up the mountain road, the car shuddered to a halt: a flat tyre, no signal, and darkness closing in fast. （读后续写·困境·转折）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （语气、情绪）平淡的，无精打采的
uncommonMeanings.example: Her voice was flat and lifeless as she read out the results, and everyone could tell that something was terribly wrong. （读后续写·情绪·低落）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （饮料）走了气的，不起泡的
uncommonMeanings.example: The lemonade had gone flat in the heat, but the thirsty hikers gulped it down all the same. （读后续写·旅途·艰苦）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 断然地，直截了当地（turn sb. down flat）
uncommonMeanings.example: When he asked for a second chance, she turned him down flat, and the coldness in her eyes told him it was truly over. （读后续写·决绝·转折）

posExamples.sentence: The curtain rises on the living room of a small flat, where a single lamp casts long shadows across walls covered with faded family photographs. （读后续写·戏剧·舞台描写）
The desert stretched flat and endless before us, and for a moment I wondered whether we would ever see the edge of it. （读后续写·探险·环境）
I am writing to inform all residents that repairs to the water pipes in our flat block will begin next Monday and may cause a brief interruption to the supply. （应用文·通知）
A society that values only material wealth risks becoming as flat and colourless as a picture drawn in a single shade of grey. （议论文·价值观·比喻论证）

idioms.translation: （笑话、计划）失败，未产生预期效果
idioms.example: His carefully rehearsed joke fell flat, and the awkward silence in the classroom made his cheeks burn. （读后续写·尴尬·校园）
For three straight weeks the volunteers worked flat out, and their tireless effort finally brought the old library back to life. （读后续写·奋斗·团队）
To everyone's amazement, the shy new boy solved the puzzle in two minutes flat. （读后续写·反转·惊喜）

collocations.example: After graduation, the three friends decided to share a tiny flat in the city, where laughter easily made up for the lack of space. （读后续写·友情·奋斗）
From the top of the block of flats, the whole glittering city lay spread out beneath our feet. （读后续写·环境·景色）
A flat tyre on a deserted road turned what should have been a joyful trip into a test of our patience and teamwork. （读后续写·困境·成长）
The scouts pitched their tents on a stretch of flat and level ground beside the murmuring stream. （读后续写·露营）
Exhausted, she lay flat on the cool grass and watched the clouds drift lazily across the summer sky. （读后续写·放松·景物）
In a flat, defeated voice he admitted that he had failed, and no one in the room knew quite what to say. （读后续写·失意·情绪）
Every attempt to cheer her up fell flat, until at last her little brother simply held her hand in silence. （读后续写·安慰·转折）
The runners went flat out over the final hundred metres, the crowd's roar pushing them beyond their limits. （读后续写·比赛·冲刺）

synonyms.example: The family moved into a bright new apartment overlooking the river. （应用文·搬家）
synonyms.usage: apartment 是美式英语，flat 是英式英语，二者意义相同；教材语境和英式写作用 flat 更地道。

synonyms.example: The workers made sure the foundation was perfectly level before laying the first brick. （议论文·工程）
synonyms.usage: level 强调水平、高低一致；flat 强调表面平整、无凸起或斜坡，二者常可换用但侧重略不同。

synonyms.example: The path grew even and smooth as it left the rocky hillside behind. （读后续写·旅途）
synonyms.usage: even 强调平整、均匀、无起伏；flat 更强调没有斜度、完全水平，描述地面、平原时二者接近。

advancedExpressions.expression: a flat ... left sb. stranded ...
advancedExpressions.example: A flat tyre left us stranded on a lonely stretch of road, with dusk falling and not a single house in sight. （用小意外触发续写转折，制造张力）

advancedExpressions.expression: residents of the flats are kindly asked to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Residents of the flats are kindly asked to keep the corridors clear so that everyone can move about safely in an emergency. （通知中礼貌提出要求）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... would be as flat and colourless as ...
advancedExpressions.example: A life without dreams would be as flat and colourless as a stage with no lights, no music, and no applause. （明喻+三项排比强化空洞感）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We had a flat tyre and were stuck on the road.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: No sooner had we set off in high spirits than a flat tyre brought the car to a jolting halt, stranding us on a deserted road as the last light drained from the sky. （读后续写·转折+环境烘托）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: No sooner...than 部分倒装制造突变 + 'jolting halt' 拟声细节 + 'the last light drained from the sky' 拟人化环境暗示危机

sentenceUpgrade.original: The living room of the flat was small and quiet.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The living room of the tiny flat lay silent and still, a single flickering lamp throwing restless shadows across walls that seemed to hold a lifetime of unspoken memories. （读后续写·戏剧舞台描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 形容词前置(silent and still) + 独立主格(a lamp throwing shadows) + 'walls that seemed to hold memories' 拟人化定语从句渲染氛围

sub_section: C 短剧示例与表演
original_sentence: He waits for a response but doesn't get one.
readingExamples: He waits for a response but doesn't get one.
definitionEn:
(1) n. something that is said, written, or done as a reaction or reply to something else
(2) n. a reaction to something that has happened or been said, especially a feeling or the way people behave
(3) n. an answer or reply, especially a formal one, to a question, letter, or request
(4) n. a physical reaction of the body to a stimulus, such as a drug or a change in conditions

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （身体、生理的）反应，应答（医学）
uncommonMeanings.example: The doctor watched anxiously for any response to the new medicine, and when the boy's fingers twitched, hope flooded the silent ward. （读后续写·医院·希望）

posExamples.sentence: He knocked again and waited for a response, but the house stayed dark and silent, as though it were holding some secret it refused to share. （读后续写·悬念·环境）
I am writing in response to your advertisement for volunteers, as I firmly believe my experience and enthusiasm make me a suitable candidate for the position. （应用文·申请信）
The overwhelming public response to the charity appeal proved, beyond all doubt, that kindness still runs deep in the heart of our community. （议论文·社会·论证）
Her only response to the cruel remark was a calm, forgiving smile, and somehow that silence spoke louder than any furious words could have. （读后续写·人物·气度）

wordForms.adjective: responsive (adj. 反应敏捷的，积极响应的)

idioms.example: In response to the growing plastic crisis, our school launched a campaign that turned thousands of bottles into blooming flower pots. （议论文·环保·响应行动）

collocations.example: In response to the teacher's call for help, more hands shot up than the class had ever seen before. （读后续写·校园·热情）
She waited, hardly breathing, for him to make some response, but he only stared at the floor in stubborn silence. （读后续写·对峙·心理）
The positive response from the audience gave the nervous young speaker the courage to finish her speech with a smile. （读后续写·演讲·成长）
The lifeguard's immediate response saved the drowning child, and the whole beach erupted into grateful applause. （读后续写·救援·英雄）
The book fair received an overwhelming response, with students queuing round the block long before the doors opened. （应用文·活动报道）
In response, he simply extended a helping hand, and that quiet gesture healed a friendship that words had failed to mend. （读后续写·和解·细节）
I look forward to receiving a favourable response to my application at your earliest convenience. （应用文·求职信结尾）
The film provoked such a strong emotional response that half the cinema was still wiping away tears as the lights came up. （议论文·艺术·感染力）

synonyms.example: She sent a warm reply the very next morning, thanking him for his thoughtful letter. （应用文·书信）
synonyms.usage: reply 多指口头或书面的直接答复；response 语义更广，既可指答复，也可指反应、反响或生理反应。

synonyms.example: His first reaction to the shocking news was one of stunned disbelief. （读后续写·惊愕）
synonyms.usage: reaction 强调不由自主、即时的生理或情绪反应；response 常带有'经过考虑后作出'的意味，更主动、正式。

synonyms.example: The student gave a clear and confident answer that impressed the whole panel. （应用文·面试）
synonyms.usage: answer 侧重对问题的直接回答；response 可指对更广泛情境（请求、事件、刺激）的回应，正式度更高。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb.'s only response was ..., which spoke louder than ...
advancedExpressions.example: His only response was a gentle nod, which spoke louder than a thousand hurried apologies ever could. （以微小动作代替言语，含蓄有力）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing in response to ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing in response to the notice recruiting student guides for the coming English festival, and I would be honoured to contribute. （申请信开门见山点明来意）

advancedExpressions.expression: the overwhelming response to ... is telling proof that ...
advancedExpressions.example: The overwhelming response to the volunteer campaign is telling proof that young people today are far from indifferent to the world around them. （用反响作为论据反驳偏见）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He waited for a response but got none.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He knocked once more and stood waiting, straining his ears for the faintest response, but only the hollow echo of his own heartbeat answered him in the deepening silence. （读后续写·悬念+心理描写）
